reason: Both conversations refused the DIY regas, but Conversation 2 explained why in a way the homeowner could understand (R600a flammable, no service valve, wrong gas in eBay kits, leak will recur) and then reached the correct diagnosis: sealed-system leak, likely from knife defrosting, uneconomic on a 9-year-old Indesit, so replace. It also surfaced the knife-damage history, ruled out the PTC relay, and gave sensible disposal and prevention advice. Conversation 1 wasted a turn on an irrelevant model-number panel, floated an unsupported 'simple fan replacement' after the no-frost evidence already pointed to gas loss, never reached the age-vs-value verdict, and oddly told him to stop using the appliance to protect the compressor, while also containing a stray inaccuracy ('illegal' regas, 'high pressure/asphyxiation') that is overstated for a 50g isobutane charge.
